About the Book
Dive into PySide6, the official Python bindings for Qt6, with this practical blueprint-style guide. This book attempts to break down essential Qt concepts into focused, reusable patterns - each featuring step-by-step walkthroughs, complete code examples, and notes.
From core fundamentals to intermediate topics, you'll master:
Widgets, layouts, buttons, input widgets, dialogs and containers
Signals, slots, custom signals, and event handling
Model-view programming
Multithreading
Object ownership, timers, properties, databases, and processes
The book is available as a free sample download. All code is available on

{"decision": "pass", "reason": "这是一本常规的 PySide6/Qt 教程书，目录完整但没有新颖的产品角度或巧妙的呈现方式，读者群体也较窄，不属于有趣的小产品。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason calls the post a conventional PySide6/Qt tutorial book with a complete table of contents, which matches the Leanpub page. Its other points (no novel angle, narrow audience) are judgments rather than invented facts. Naming PySide6/Qt and the book format ties the reason to this post, and arguing it lacks novelty and has a narrow audience supports the pass.
